info.title: CloudWatch / CWAgent Metrics Fetcher
info.description: Fetches one CloudWatch metric for one EC2 instance

get.summary: Fetch one metric for one EC2 instance
get.description: Returns datapoints and a summary for a single metric on a single instance. AWS/EC2 metrics (no agent needed): CPUUtilization, CPUCreditBalance, CPUCreditUsage, StatusCheckFailed, StatusCheckFailed_Instance, StatusCheckFailed_System, NetworkIn, NetworkOut, EBSReadOps, EBSWriteOps, EBSIOBalance%. CloudWatch-agent metrics: mem_used_percent, swap_used_percent, disk_used_percent (pass path, e.g. /), procstat_lookup_pid_count. The namespace is picked automatically. Pass time_string whenever an incident time is known.

parameters.name: metric_name
parameters.description: Metric to fetch (see the list above).

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Filesystem mount path for disk_used_percent, e.g. /. Omit for other metrics.

parameters.name: time_string
parameters.description: Exact UTC incident time, YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS. The query centres on it.

parameters.name: window_minutes
parameters.description: With time_string: minutes before and after the incident (1-180).

parameters.name: hours_back
parameters.description: Without time_string: hours back from now (1-72).

parameters.name: namespace
parameters.description: Only to override the automatic choice. Leave unset.
